text:
ryan: FYI noticed a spike in 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning, mostly from mixed-dim batched requests. attaching a tiny log sample. :eyes:

kevin: Can you paste a request example? wondering if client is packing different dims in same batch or if our splitter is choking.

ryan: Yep — example curl from user: 
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -H 'X-Embed-Dimensions: 768,1024' \\
  -d '{"inputs": ["a","b","c"]}'\n```\nThey use our SDK which currently doesn't enforce a single-dim preflight. we attempt to split server-side but saw a lot of 413s before fallback kicked in.

lina: Interesting — runtime logs show: `embed.split_attempt=1` then immediate `http.response_code=413` and `embed.split_success=0` for ~30% of those. Looks like the preflight/route decision path is racing with the splitter queue and hitting the 413 size guard.

kevin: Hmm — that means two problems: 1) our size-guard is too aggressive for split candidates, 2) telemetry doesn't differentiate preflight fastfail vs post-split 413s. We should emit a distinct tag `embed.413_phase=preflight|postsplit`.

ryan: Agreed. Also product asked for a better console hint when requests are being auto-split. Sarah: any preferences for UX?

sarah: We should surface a per-route metric in the console showing `split_rate` (requests that needed splitting) and `split_failure_rate` (requests that failed before split). Tooltip should explain what split does and link to docs. For rollout, do a canary behind a flag `size_aware_routing` then opt-in for tenants with high split_volume. :memo:

kevin: Implementation plan from infra/runtime POV: 
- Add `embed.413_phase` tag (preflight/postsplit).
- Emit `embed.split_attempt` (counter) + `embed.split_success` (counter) with route and tenant tags.
- Change the size-guard to allow split candidates up to 2x current threshold if splitter is enabled for that tenant.
- Add server-side circuit that fastfails when splitter queue depth > N to avoid head-of-line blocking.

lina: Also for batching: the router should include a `preferred_dim` hint derived from first item in batch to route to the right shard first; fallback to split if mismatch. That reduces split cost for common-case clients that are consistent.

ryan: For SDKs: maybe emit a warning when client mixes dims and provide a `fastfail_on_mixed_dims` opt-in until we roll out size-aware routing. We should coordinate message/versions across SDKs.

sarah: Dashboard panels: 
- Timeseries: `embed.split_rate` per-route (last 7d).
- Gauge: `embed.split_success_rate` (success/attempt).
- Heatmap: `avg_latency_split_vs_nosplit`.
- Alert: `split_failure_rate > 5%` for > 10m.
Add a small UX card recommending `enable size_aware_routing` with a one-click toggle for Enterprise tenants.

kevin: For telemetry naming, propose: `infra.embedding.split_attempt.count`, `infra.embedding.split_success.count`, `infra.embedding.413.phase{preflight|postsplit}.count`. Keep prefix `infra.` so product and OSS metrics stay distinct.

lina: perf note: when a split happens we create extra KV cache misses — add `embed.kvcache_miss_on_split` metric to quantify.

ryan: quick repro script I used to generate failure spike attached to thread (small load test). i can share on GDrive.

infra-bot: deploy job #deploy-embed-splitter-v2 started by @kevin — canary to 10% of runtime nodes. :rocket:

kevin: I'm going to send a small rollout: flag `size_aware_routing` default off, enable for canary tenants, monitor `infra.embedding.split_success.count` and `infra.embedding.413.phase` for regressions. If split_success goes up and postsplit 413 down, expand to 50%.

sarah: I'll add console mockups (tooltip + panels) to the UX board and link it here once done. We need copy that explains cost implications (splitting increases token work and may increase billing; show estimated cost delta).

ryan: Action items: 
- kevin: telemetry + guard tweak (PR by EOD).
- lina: add KV cache metric + batch hint routing change (small patch).
- sarah: console panels + tooltip copy (mockup by tomorrow).
- ryan: share repro & customer context (sensitivity) and coordinate SDK warnings.

kevin: I'll also add a short log line so ops can filter `embed.413_phase=preflight` quickly: `WARN embed: preflight-413 tenant=%s route=%s`.

lina: One more thought — instrument the splitter queue size with per-tenant tags so we can see which customers are being affected and add a softquota that returns 429 with `Retry-After` when they exceed split budget. Safer than opaque 413s.

ryan: +1 to softquota 429. Much clearer for users.

sarah: OK let's reconvene after the canary results. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
